Character reference sheet, two views on one image against pure white background: left, full-body front view standing straight, arms relaxed at sides; right, close-up of the face at three-quarter angle, neutral expression, looking slightly past camera. Chinese man around 45, lean hard build, long weathered face with high cheekbones, narrow black eyes, short black beard trimmed square, black topknot. Sui mingguang iron lamellar armor with two polished round breast mirrors, dark red silk cloak, iron helmet with a black tassel crest, a riding whip in hand. Clearly younger and leaner than any grey- or white-bearded general. Helmet on, sword sheathed at the hip, cloak thrown back over the shoulders, whip held down at the side, in the full-body view. Must look clearly different from any white-bearded or grey-bearded general: beard short, black, square-trimmed, around 45 years old, lean.
